about: Scrub trough modelled as a generic product: stainless apron, rim, end walls, sloped trough floor, upstand with capping, per bay a wall spout, sensor window, TMV access panel, knee paddle and waste. Per type: the insertion point is the left end; bay 1 is shared, bay 2 shows in the 2- and 3-bay types, bay 3 in the 3-bay type, and the body grows to 600 mm per bay. CW/HW/waste are arrayed per bay; the bay 2-3 connectors exist in every type (Revit can't switch connectors per type) and stay unconnected where the bay is hidden. The 3-bay type's waste holes for bays 2-3 are drawn as plugs because voids can't vary by type.
